title: TOTAL SAILOR: FIT TO FIGHT (TSFTF) WORKSHOPS RESILIENCE KEYNOTE SPEAKER
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSUP > NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT > NAVSUP FLC PEARL HARBOR > NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR PEARL HARBOR
description:
This is a SOLICITATION for commercial services prepared in accordance with RFO Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services, as supplemented with the additional information included in this notice. This solicitation SHALL be posted on SAM.gov. 

 The RFQ number is N0060427Q4008. Applicable FAR and DFARS RFO and RFO DFARS provisions and clauses shall apply. It is the responsibility of the contractor to be familiar with the applicable clauses and provisions. The clauses may be accessed in full text at these addresses: 

 https://www.acquisition.gov/far-overhaul/far-part-deviation-guide/far-over-haul-part-52 and http://www.acq.osd.mil/dpap/dars/dfarspgi/current/index.html.  

 The NAICS code is 611430 – Professorial and Management Development Training and the Small Business Standard is $15 Million. 

 This requirement is a 100% Total Small Business Set-aside. The Small Business Office concurs with this decision. 

 NAVSUP FLC Pearl Harbor seeks quotes from qualified sources capable of providing services specified in PWS. 

 The requirement will result in a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) purchase order. 

 The method of payment will be Wide Area Workflow (WAWF). Payment after Government acceptance. 

 Please review carefully the Attachment 1 – Solicitation in its entirety; specifically: 

 
	   Section C – Description/Specifications/Statement of Work (PWS)   
	  Section L – Instructions, Conditions, & Notices to Offerors or Quoters (Quote submission Requirements)  
	  Section M – Evaluation Factors for Award  
 

 And submit all requested documents and video. 

 Attachment 2 – Training sessions includes all sessions, hours per session and location. 

 Attachment 3 -Suggested Pricing Format is optional. Quoters may use this attachment to submit their prices, or they can use their own Excel document to submit cost breakdown of their quote.  

  Due date for submitting questions is:  

  Thursday 03 December 2026 @ 0400PM Hawaiian Standard Time  

 Any question submitted after the deadline will not be entertained. 

  Due date for submitting quotes is:  

  Thursday 10 December 2026 @ 0400PM Hawaiian Standard Time  

 Any quote submitted after the deadline will not be considered. 

 Please submit your questions or quotes by email to dawit.t.gebreyesus.civ@us.navy.mil .
